subject: Emberlink + Redwood: vector sync pilot & scope
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Rao <samir@emberlink.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Emberlink + Redwood: vector sync pilot & scope

Samir —

Thanks for the intro call last week. To kick off the pilot I put together a short scope so we all start with the same expectations:

- Goal: Validate Emberlink’s real-time vector sync into Redwood runtime + S3-backed coldstore fallback.
- Success metrics: end-to-end latency <= 80ms P50 for lookup, end-to-end sync throughput 200 inserts/sec sustained, and accuracy parity (+/- 1% on eval prompts).
- Pilot surface area: one test dataset (~150k documents), PGVector replica + S3 archive, and a hosted Pinecone namespace for comparison.
- Timeline: 3 weeks of integration + 2 weeks of joint evaluation.

Can Marcus and Dev weigh in on the infra/blockers — specifically around prefix caching and quantized model runtimes? Laura, I’d like a slim mutual action plan and a doc that we can hand to our CS/SE teams.

I’ve attached a 1-pager and the initial dataflow spec. Proposed kickoff: Wed 2027-06-23, 10:00 PT (Cal link below).

Thanks,
Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Head of Partner GTM, Redwood Inference

Tessa —

Appreciate the clear kickoff doc. A few quick clarifications from our side:

1) Emberlink will stream embeddings -> target stores. We support direct Pinecone writes, a pgvector sink, and an S3 event archive (Parquet). For the pgvector sink, we expect an insert QPS up to 500 for short bursts.
2) For S3 coldstore we’ll provide manifest files and partitioning keys; is Redwood expecting a specific prefix layout? Our default is year=/month=/day= partitions.
3) Security: we’ll need a short checklist for required IAM roles and a temporary cross-account role for the sandbox S3. Also, would Redwood want us to sign a data processing addendum for the pilot?

We can take the lead on the Pinecone compare namespace; Olivia from Pinecone is copied to coordinate.

I’ll attach our onboarding packet (includes example manifests). Proposed: we still meet Wed; I’ll have infra and product on the call.

—Samir
Samir Rao
Head of Integrations, Emberlink

Samir —

Quick tech checklist from Redwood infra:

- Schema: we’ll want stable ids + embedding vectors as float32 (we can accept float16 on the wire if you provide dimensionality). What is Emberlink’s default embedding dim?
- Batching: please confirm max batch size (we prefer < 2048 vectors per batch for prefix cache warmup patterns).
- Backfill: for the initial 150k docs, do you stream a manifest-based backfill or do we pull on-demand?
- KV cache compatibility: when requests hit Redwood runtime we rely on prefix KV caching; to keep cache efficiency we need consistent keys (doc id + version). Can Emberlink include a version token per object?
- Quantized model note: if we surface 8-bit quantized models on the runtime side, do you expect any differences in nearest-neighbor recall we should test for?

If you can reply before Wed we’ll put answers into the runbook. Also, provide the service principal ARN we should allow for the cross-account role.

—Dev
Dev Patel

All —

Thanks for the notes. Quick answers inline and next steps:

- Embedding dim: default is 1536 (we can downsample to 768 if you prefer). We’ll send vectors as float32 over gRPC; batch size default 512 (we can tune).
- Backfill: Emberlink will perform a manifest-based backfill into the sandbox S3 location (s3://emberlink-sandbox/redwood-sync/) and then stream deltas to pgvector and Pinecone.
- Versioning: we include a monotonic version token in every record — will work for prefix cache TTLs.
- Quantized models: we’ll run the Pinecone parity with both float32 and quantized-8 runtimes to check recall.
- IAM: Emberlink service principal is arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/emberlink-sync-role — please add it to the cross-account role policy.
- Soc2: we’ll fill out the 12-item checklist today and share by EOD.

I created the kickoff cal invite (https://cal.com/emberlink/redwood-kickoff) for Wed 2027-06-23 10:00 PT. We’ll bring infra, product, and SRE. Looking forward — Samir will send the onboarding packet and sample manifests after this thread.

—Samir
Samir Rao
Head of Integrations, Emberlink
